idea-plugin.name: OS Lab — Instructor-Controlled LLM
idea-plugin.description:
Student client for the OS Lab instructor-controlled LLM platform, embedded directly in CLion. Log in with your course code, read your personalized exercise briefing, and chat with the locally-hosted tutor model without leaving the IDE. Comprehension probes from the instructor appear inline.

Behavior is chosen by the backend's STUDENT_CLIENT_MODE setting:
  • chat — faithful chat experience: login, briefing, streaming chat, probes.
  • ide — also scaffolds your assigned variant's starter C file into the open project and shows the test inputs you must pass as a checklist.
